verdict.rationale: Featurebase markets user-built workflows (SLAs, automatic trial extensions, discounts) and an AI agent, Fibi, that resolves customer issues on its own, so it ships first-party background automation. The evidence is marketing-level only: there is no documentation of how workflows are configured, what triggers them, whether they can run on a recurring schedule, or how they execute unattended. Webhooks are an outbound building block and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented workflow builder details (triggers/conditions/actions), recurring schedule support, execution logs or monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Build workflows for SLAs, automatically extending trials, offering discounts, and much more.
Let Fibi AI agent automatically resolve customer issues and cut down support loads for your team.
Featurebase automatically notifies all relevant users when their requests are shipped. No more manual follow-ups.
